about_short_description.short_description: Datasaur develops productive tools that design for data labelling needs.

product.name: Data Studio
product.description: A platform for data labeling that improves the efficiency of NLP projects through structured annotation workflows.

product.name: LLM Labs
product.description: A platform to build, compare, and optimize custom Large Language Models using over 250 AI models to reduce project costs and improve model performance.

product.name: LLM-Assisted Labeling
product.description: A feature that automates NLP data labeling by using multiple Large Language Models simultaneously to generate label predictions and improve annotation accuracy.

product.name: Knowledge Base
product.description: A specialized database for storing and managing vector embeddings of text data to provide domain-specific context for LLMs.

product.name: Data Programming - Labeling Function Analysis
product.description: A tool to evaluate and optimize programmatic labeling functions by measuring coverage, overlap, and conflicts to improve automated data annotation accuracy.
